verdict.rationale: Jan's evidence shows local inference plus connections to third-party providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq). Nothing documents a Jan-hosted cloud inference tier, let alone its pricing tiers, rate limits, or usage caps. A local-first AI app could plausibly offer a hosted tier, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence yields none. Third-party integrations are a different feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
